subject: general
question: The main focus of _______ is on recording and classifying monetary transactions in the books of accounts and preparation of financial statements at the end of every accounting period.
solution:
The correct answer is **financial accounting.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Financial Accounting:**

 
 
• Primarily concerned with the systematic recording, classifying, and summarizing of financial transactions.
 
• Focuses on preparing financial statements, such as the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement, which are used by external stakeholders including investors, creditors, and regulatory agencies.
 
• Ensures that the financial information presented is accurate and in compliance with regulatory standards and accounting principles.
 
• Helps stakeholders assess the financial health, performance, and changes in the financial position of an enterprise.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Environmental Accounting:**

 
 
• Focuses on accounting for environmental costs and benefits.
 
• Involves the identification, measurement, and allocation of environmental costs, and the integration of these costs into business decisions and financial reports.
 
 
 
• **Forensic Accounting:**
 
 
• Specializes in investigating financial fraud and disputes.
 
• Involves analyzing financial information to detect and prevent fraud and to support legal proceedings.
 
 
 
• **Cost Accounting:**
 
 
• Focuses on calculating and controlling costs associated with manufacturing or providing services.
 
• Helps businesses in budgeting, cost control, and cost reduction strategies.
